title: auth
description: Authenticate with the client secret (5 attempts per connection). Query-string tokens are not supported. Carries the client info: protocol_version, platform, app_version required, app_build and device_model optional. The hub stores them per device (Admin API) and checks them after the secret: a valid secret with a too old app yields upgrade_required + close 4426; a tombstoned secret still yields client_removed first. Invalid client info (unknown platform, malformed version) yields auth_error.

protocol_version.description: Protocol version the app speaks. Missing or below the hub's min_protocol_version: the hub answers upgrade_required and closes 4426.

app_version.description: Below min_app_version[platform] of the hub: upgrade_required, close 4426.
